title: Verdacht des schweren Menschenhandels und des gewerbsmäßigen Einschleusens von Ausländern – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed 20 search warrants across eight Berlin districts in an investigation of suspected aggravated human trafficking and commercial smuggling of foreigners. Eighteen suspects are accused of housing at least eleven Vietnamese women in Berlin flats for prostitution; ten suspects were found, and one police officer was slightly injured.
